warnings: Rows with incomplete public evidence are preserved as needs_more_data and are not silently upgraded.
Hold/reject investors are excluded from import and retained in excluded_investors.json.
Duplicate/out-of-window/out-of-scope financing rows are excluded from funding-round upserts and retained in excluded_deals.json.
Unnamed or unmatched investor mentions remain in unresolved_relations.json and do not create investor records.
